origin: docx-eval; bases 01/02 are NimbleOffice (formerly BetterOffice) table fixtures (Apache-2.0; byte-identical to crates/docx-edit/tests/fixtures/table-split-bands/), the floattable-* bases are LibreOffice QA documents (MPL-2.0)
license: bases 01/02: Apache-2.0; floattable-*: MPL-2.0; generated variants inherit their base's license

float-pagination.varies: text before / after a page-anchored float (tblpY 85pt), anchor kind, compat mode
word: compat 14, no text before (vA): page one fills to min(footer line, top + body height); 01 ends at line 41 (742.32pt), 02 at row 18
compat 14 with a title before (v0): the title wraps beside the float in a narrow column; the first cut follows the text on the page
vB: Word leaves an exclusion artefact (float ends 233pt, text keeps wrapping to 496pt): iterative layout, not a rule to copy

compat15-move.varies: compat 15: float position vs text above it, overlap, text after, table height
word: a float that must split, positioned above body text already on the page, moves to the next page at the same tblpY
no text above (a), one short line above (f), position below the text (b): stays on page one
five rows that fit (s-short5-c15): stays, text wraps beside it
c-y8000 (tblpY 400pt): Word pulls the float up to about 207pt instead of moving it; rule not yet derived

legacy-pre-anchor-wrap.varies: k paragraphs before a legacy page float (k = 1..30), anchor paragraph with text
word: text before the anchor wraps beside the float; the first page's cut = min(footer line, top + body height - text already on the page)

footer-vs-compat.varies: floattable-footer-2rows (compat 15) vs floattable-avoid-last-manip-ofst (compat 12): row height, footer, column count
word: the compat mode decides: compat 15 cuts row 3 at the body bottom (536pt), compat 12 completes it to 563.76pt; trHeight, footers and column count change nothing
